reuse_search.judgement: The catalogue snapshot is duplicated rather than extended: snapshot_pilot_signals at plant_context_graph.py:64 repeats the control and stability reads of snapshot_archive_signals at variable_name_graph.py:63 and inlines its COUNT_QUERY. The row formatter, selector parser and record models are reused from their owners, and the writer consumes GraphSchema.get_relationships_from rather than re-deriving relationship metadata; the trivial merge_node_query at graph/schema.py:859 has no facility scoping or acknowledgement and is unused in production, so the new writer is not a fork of it, though it does not extend it either.
